Rain (loopable) — Ylmir
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/rain-loopable
Download: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/Rain%20OGG.zip
License: CC0 1.0 Universal
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The author describes four loopable rain recordings, 25–45 seconds long,
recorded at a window with a mono microphone and processed into stereo.
This project includes 4.ogg from that pack. Attribution is provided voluntarily.

Derived asset: Assets/Demo/Resources/Audio/Rain soft loop.wav
Processing: rumble/high-frequency reduction, RMS 0.035, PCM16 stereo 44.1 kHz.
See Tools/build_car_intro_audio.py and Docs/CarIntro/music-edit.json.
The original recording is preserved above; the derived sound is used in the
car cinematic and DemoWeather. No synthetic rain is used when it is available.
